title: Delete a draft anchor
content_data:
Use this endpoint to delete an anchor in draft mode that was created on the [TikTok One](https://ads.tiktok.com/creative) platform. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/anchor/delete/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | |anchor_id {Required}|string|Anchor ID.

To obtain a draft anchor within your TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account, use [/tto/tcm/anchor/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1826564965840066) and confirm that the `status` of the anchor is `DRAFT`.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/anchor/delete/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access_Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "tto_tcm_account_id" : "{{tto_tcm_account_id}}", "anchor_id" : "{{anchor_id}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
